notes.title: Guardian Trailer 3 - Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
notes.content:
[h2]Bugs. Why did it have to be bugs?! Even sneaky traps and fearsome [b]Magaori[/b] are no match against [b]scholar Akazu[/b] and[b] baby-faced elder Koro[/b]. [/h2]

[h3][b]Akazu [/b]loves [b]learning [/b]and usually [b]holes up in the tower[/b] to [b]read [/b]dense [b]books [/b]and [b]conduct [/b][b]secret experiments[/b].[/h3]

[h3][b]Koro [/b]is the[b] former elde[/b]r of [b]Shinju Village[/b] and also has a [b]great memory[/b], shown in his [b]ability[/b] to [b]remember events[/b] of even when he was a kid.[/h3]
